title: Wedding kit (template) — date, budget, guest count
description: Qualify the event. Save the lead. Human for the creative close.

hero.headline: From date and budget to a real booking conversation.
hero.copy: Families WhatsApp five planners the same night. This kit asks date, city, guest count, and budget band, then books a call. It does not design the wedding in chat.

guardrails: No final package price in bot

messages.text: Need a planner for a wedding in Jaipur this December.
Guest count and budget band — under 15L, 15–30L, or 30L+?
Recorded. A planner will confirm a 20-min call with three date options.

problem.title: The serious family already talked to someone faster.
copy: You are on a site visit. The WhatsApp is on a staff phone.
Budget and date never get written down.

fixes.title: Lead saved
fixes.copy: Season rush does not erase the thread.

cards.title: Fit check
cards.copy: Out of city or below minimum budget routes politely out.

workflow.title: Instagram and referrals into one qualified card.
workflow.copy: The planner walks into the call with numbers already there.

stop: Hold a venue you do not control

niches.title: Planners, caterers, décor
niches.copy: Caterers swap ‘menu tasting slot’ for planner call.

control.title: The planner owns the pitch.
control.copy: Bot is a filter, not the closer.

faq.a: No. Budget band only. Price is on the call.
Yes — same kit, tasting instead of design call.

form.title: Build a wedding demo from this kit.

whatsapp.demoText: Hi Webwise, I want a wedding kit demo.

resultCard.leakLabel: One missed qualified wedding is a large leak. Range only.
resultCard.story: You do not need more Instagram. You need the December family to get a reply tonight.

leakQuiz.q: How fast do you reply after hours?

rules.systemPrompt: Wedding enquiry qualifier. Capture date, city, guests, budget band. Book a planner call. No venue holds, no final package price.

approved.response: Ask city, guest count, budget band. Offer to book a call.

rules.fallback: A planner will continue this conversation.
